base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: DDR5 configuration and status live in a greatly expanded mode-register (MR) space (MR0..MRxx, dozens of registers vs DDR4's MR0..MR7), accessed by Mode Register Write (MRW) and Mode Register Read (MRR) commands over the 2-cycle CA protocol. The groups below summarize the DDR5 mode-register surface.

register_addressing.write_command: MRW — MRW-1 carries MA[6:0], MRW-2 carries OP[7:0] data.
register_addressing.read_command: MRR — returns OP[7:0] of the addressed mode register on DQ.

wck2ck_sync_options.meaning: Free-Start — start WCK immediately, may precede multiple reads/writes.
Read-optimized — optimize WCK timing for an immediately following read.
Write-optimized — optimize WCK timing for an immediately following write.

write_x_options.meaning: Fill burst with all-zeros without transferring data.
Fill burst with all-ones without transferring data.

bank_modes.meaning: 16 banks, 4 bank groups x 4 banks; tCCD_L/tRRD_L same-group spacing.

register_classes.purpose: Program RL, WL, burst length, parity latency per channel.
Output driver strength / ODT for DQ/WDQS/RDQS/CA at 6.4 Gb/s/pin.
Enable/configure on-die ECC and link ECC; ECC reporting.
Refresh rate, RFM thresholds, temperature-compensated refresh.
Select pseudo-channel vs legacy channel operation.
CA parity, soft-repair requests, error-severity logging, alerts.
IEEE-1500 / direct-access test, MBIST, loopback, KGSD.

representative_mode_register_fields.description: Clocks from READ to first read-data beat.
Clocks from WRITE to first write-data beat.
Data burst length per column access.
Enables ECC across the channel data bus.
Post-package soft repair of a failing row/column.
Direct-access / loopback test through the base die.

access_mechanism.write: Mode Register Set (MRS) on the per-channel row command/address bus with the channel idle.
access_mechanism.read: Mode Register Read (MRR) / status readout on the channel.
access_mechanism.scope: Mode registers are per-channel; the 16 channels are configured independently.

register_access.purpose: Configure burst length, latencies, DFE taps, VrefDQ/VrefCA, on-die-ECC, refresh management, and equalization; read status and error counts.

fields: Read / write latency and preamble settings
Error Check and Scrub (ECS) control and counters
CA training, write leveling, read/write training control
